verdict.overall: Since Sunday, most single names have rallied hard (TSLA, AVGO, ZETA, BE and AMAT all up 9-18%), pushing floors and ceilings higher, but TSLA, AVGO and APP now show opposing options on at least one expiry, hinting resistance is building after the run. NVDA is the weakest, down nearly 13% with pricey nearest-week options and earnings on November 17 landing inside this window. SPY and QQQ remain the calmest, best-defined ranges for steady swing trades, so confidence there is holding steady even as confidence in chasing the recent single-stock rallies looks shakier.
